newsitem.title: USA: DII Group unit gets U.S. Robotics contract.
newsitem.headline: DII Group unit gets U.S. Robotics contract.

text.p: The DII Group Inc said its contract electronics manufacturing unit, DOVatron International, had won a contract with U.S. Robotics.
The terms of this agreement have not been disclosed.
The company said the unit will provide a variety of full turnkey assembly solutions to U.S. Robotics from several of its factories world-wide.
DOVatron International Inc is an ISO 9002 certified global contract manufacturer with locations in New York, Colorado, Southern California, Florida, Ireland, Malaysia and Mexico.
